domains.title: Custom domain
domains.description: Serve your storefront on your own web address, like www.yourshop.in. We check your DNS, then set up HTTPS for you.
domains.setupFirst: Set up your storefront first, then come back to connect a domain.
domains.freeAddress: Your free address is always available:
domains.emptyDesc: Buy a domain from any registrar, then connect it below. It takes about 5 minutes.
domains.limitNote: You can connect up to {max} domains. One of them is your primary domain; visitors on the others are sent there, which is best for Google.

form.label: Your domain
form.hint: For example www.yourshop.in or yourshop.in. No https:// needed.
form.success: Domain added. Follow the steps below to point it at your storefront.

actions.rechecked: Check started. This page updates by itself.
actions.removeConfirm: Remove {host}? Visitors will no longer reach your storefront through it.
actions.autoRefresh: Checking automatically. You can leave this page open.

pending_dns.label: Waiting for DNS
pending_dns.help: Add the records below at your domain provider. Changes can take from a few minutes to a few hours to spread.

verifying.label: Checking
verifying.help: We are checking your DNS records now.

verified.label: DNS verified
verified.help: Your records are correct. We are setting up secure access (HTTPS).

provisioning_tls.label: Issuing certificate
provisioning_tls.help: Your records are correct. Your HTTPS certificate is being issued, usually within a few minutes.

active.label: Active
active.help: Your domain is live and serving your storefront over HTTPS.

misconfigured.label: Needs attention
misconfigured.help: Something is wrong with this domain. See what we found below, fix it, then press Check again.

card.nameHint: Most providers want the name without your domain at the end, for example www instead of www.example.com. Remove any old A or AAAA records on the same name first.
card.compareCaption: Comparison of expected and observed DNS for {host}
card.serversAnswer: Our servers answer at your domain

analytics.title: Storefront traffic
analytics.description: Who visits your storefront and where they come from. We do not use cookies or store IP addresses; visitors are counted with a hash that changes every day.
analytics.noStorefrontDesc: Publish your storefront and traffic will show up here.
analytics.requestsHint: All requests, incl. crawlers and files
analytics.noVisits: No visits recorded in this period yet. Numbers update every few minutes.
analytics.botNote: Search engines and AI assistants (for example Googlebot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot) read your storefront so you can be found. They are counted here, not as visitors. {count} bot visits in this period.

source.ai_assistant: AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Copilot)

charts.aria: Page views and visitors per day. {total} page views in this period.
